model: KDMClassModel (kdm-torch), encoder=nn.Identity(), n_comp=len(X_train) (memory-based), x_train=y_train=w_train=False, sigma_trainable=True, 300 epochs full-batch Adam(lr=1e-2)
note: better than confidence_logistic (0.576) but still worse than the always-'clear' naive baseline (0.527).
